---
title: "Topic: business finance"
---

**Access to equity finance**

- **Definition:** whether the firm sought and successfully obtained equity finance (external capital in exchange for ownership share) in the reference year
- **Metric:** binary indicator for equity finance application (yes/no); binary indicator for successful equity finance (yes/no)

---

**Equity finance for R&D and innovation**

- **Definition:** whether equity finance obtained by the firm was directed towards research, development, or other innovation activities
- **Metric:** binary indicator (yes/no)

---

**Access to debt finance**

- **Definition:** whether the firm sought and successfully obtained debt finance (repayable borrowing) in the reference year
- **Metric:** binary indicator for debt finance application (yes/no); binary indicator for successful debt finance (yes/no)

---

**Debt finance for R&D and innovation**

- **Definition:** whether debt finance obtained by the firm was directed towards research, development, or other innovation activities
- **Metric:** binary indicator (yes/no)

---

**Receipt of public financial support**

- **Definition:** whether the firm received public financial support - via grants, subsidised loans, or loan guarantees - from local, national, or EU-level government in the reference year
- **Metric:** binary indicator (yes/no); total amount received in € by source (local/regional, national, EU)

---

**Public financial support for R&D and innovation**

- **Definition:** share of public financial support received that was directed towards research, development, or other innovation activities
- **Metric:** binary indicator (yes/no); amount directed to R&D and innovation in €

---

**Application for public financial support**

- **Definition:** whether the firm applied for public financial support - via grants, subsidised loans, or loan guarantees - from local, national, or EU-level sources in the reference year
- **Metric:** binary indicator (yes/no); number of applications by source (local/regional, national, EU)
